body.name: Min-cut and finite outer optimization
body.construction: \(\mathsf{Alg}\) evaluates \(h_{\mu}(S)\) by one source--row--column--sink minimum cut for each \(S\subseteq E\), and evaluates the outer optimum by enumerating \((A,B)\in\mathcal F_{\tau}\), deduplicating \(A-B\), and ordering the retained sets by \(\prec\).
